article.headline: Jaion Pitt scores 26 to lead Pacific to 71-62 victory over Omaha
article.description: — Jaion Pitt scored 26 points and Pacific beat Omaha 71-62 on Thursday night at the Resorts World Classic.
article.linkText: Jaion Pitt scores 26 to lead Pacific to 71-62 victory over Omaha
article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Jaion Pitt scored 26 points and Pacific beat Omaha 71-62 on Thursday night at the Resorts World Classic. Pitt made 8 of 15 shots with a 3-pointer and 9 of 11 free throws for the Tigers (6-2). Gavin Ripp posted a double-double with 11 points and 10 rebounds. CJ Jones scored 10 on 3-for-18 shooting. Cahmai Crosby had 17 points and five rebounds off the bench for the Mavericks (3-5). Jonny Jordan Jr. had 12 points and Grant Stubblefield totaled 10 points, seven assists and five rebounds. Pacific went on a 15-1 run to start the game, but Omaha whittled the lead down to 32-25 by halftime. The Tigers never surrendered their lead in the second half. Up next: Pacific plays UC Davis on Friday as the event continues, and Omaha takes on Jacksonville State. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
